title: Gorgias Review (2026)
intro: Gorgias is evaluated here as an ecommerce helpdesk with order-aware support workflows — Gorgias is an ecommerce-native helpdesk for Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce support teams with order, refund, and customer context in the agent workspace. Ticket-based pricing (not per-agent): Starter $40/mo for 50 tickets; Basic $77/mo billed annually ($90/mo monthly). AI and automation features bundled into ticket tiers. Scored as ecommerce-helpdesk primary — not ranked against generic ITSM or live-chat-only peers. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Gorgias when ecommerce order context, Shopify depth, and ticket-based pricing match your DTC support model — not for generic B2B helpdesk or ITSM.
verdict: Choose Gorgias when ecommerce order context, Shopify depth, and ticket-based pricing match your DTC support model — not for generic B2B helpdesk or ITSM. Compare Freshdesk or Zendesk Suite for non-ecommerce omnichannel helpdesk. Do not force-rank against live-chat or ITSM peers. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Agents work tickets with storefront order, refund, and customer context in the same inbox — a clearer weekly ritual than a generic shared mailbox. Not hands-on tested.
First-party coverage is ecommerce-helpdesk (Shopify/Magento/BigCommerce), not ITSM. Score the job as order-aware store support — skip if the weekly work is B2B tickets or internal IT.
Ticketing, SLA routing, and macros/automation are documented as supported, including refund/edit-order macros in the agent workspace. Depth is ecommerce workflows, not ITIL change boards.
Omnichannel inbox, live chat, and social channels are documented; phone-support is not. Treat this as storefront + chat/email, not a voice-first suite.
Knowledge-base is supported; the self-service portal is only limited in first-party research. Expect agent-side macros more than a docs-first Help Scout motion.
Helpdesk integrations plus native Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce order context are the product’s reason to exist. Weak fit if those storefronts are not the system of record.
Helpdesk reporting is documented, including revenue-adjacent support analytics. Confirm which reports ship on Starter vs higher ticket tiers before you model ops dashboards.
Starter is 50 tickets at $40/month; Basic is $77/month billed annually. Ticket caps and overage — not agent seats — are the scale constraint.
No published free plan; 7-day trial. Ticket+AI packaging can beat per-agent math at modest DTC volume and lose when overage dominates. Confirm live caps.
Chatbot/AI agent and agent copilot are documented as supported, bundled into ticket tiers rather than a separate per-agent AI SKU. Model AI against ticket volume, not seat count.
